svg.title: True sinusoidal pattern versus a possible pseudo-sinusoidal mimic
svg.desc: Two 3-minute synthetic excerpts at US paper scale. Left: smooth, regular sine wave around 140 bpm, plus or minus 10 bpm, 4 cycles per minute (one cycle every 15 seconds), no irregular variability or accelerations; the pattern must persist for 20 minutes or more to be called sinusoidal. Right: normal irregular variability for the first 45 and last 45 seconds, with jagged, irregular quasi-periodic oscillation between. External toco below each with contractions at 0.75 and 2.25 minutes.
